description:
Advertise Rain or Shine With Plastic Signs


Be seen and heard no matter the weather with custom plastic signs. With good design skills, you’ll reap a lot of benefits from this low-cost and versatile marketing tool. 

Like other outdoor promotional materials, plastic signs can last for years with proper care and maintenance. Don’t worry about disposal, though – our plastic signs are made of naturally occurring plastic compounds which make them eco-friendly and recyclable.

If you’re looking for a cost-effective option for your directional signage, architectural signage, real estate signage, trade show signage, giant checks, and more, try out plastic signs.

Create Eye-Catching Plastic Signs at UPrinting


Here at UPrinting, you can get your custom plastic signs in a wide range of materials, shapes, and sizes.

We can print your order on different thicknesses of white PVC board, clear acrylic, and even corrugated plastic. Apart from the standard shapes such as rectangle/square, oval, circle, and octagon, we can also do custom requests. Custom sizes up to 48” x 96” or 96” x 48” are also accepted.
